references.text: Bethlehem is mentioned here as the birthplace of the Messiah, and it is the same city referred to in Zebulun's inheritance in Joshua 19:15, although this is a different Bethlehem than the more well-known one in Judah.
Nahalal (Nahalol) is mentioned here as a city in Zebulun's territory where the Canaanites were not driven out, the same city as in Joshua 19:15.
Bethlehem in Zebulun is mentioned as the home of the judge Ibzan, the same Bethlehem as in Joshua 19:15.
Nahalal is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the Merarites from the tribe of Zebulun, the same city as in Joshua 19:15.
